name: Hermetic grain bag
structure: Woven PP fabric 120 µm / LLDPE 37 µm / EVOH 4 µm / LLDPE 37 µm

seal.method: Liner twisted, folded and tied airtight

recyclability.label: Reusable
recyclability.note: Reusable for two to three seasons if the liner is not punctured.

cautions: Grain must be dried below 13 % moisture before sealing, or it moulds inside the bag.
One puncture breaks the seal: keep away from rodents.
